synopsis: Chapter 12 attributes Stage-Gate / phase-gate to Robert Cooper, dating it to 1990 with an update in 2008 [f9501, f10004]. The method imposes defined phases with management decisions between them [f9500]. Chapter 12 records hybridization with agile methods in 2016, while the glossary specifies that this Agile-Stage-Gate hybrid brought agile methods into physical product development [f9501, f16422]. The supplied facts agree on this chronology but do not explain how the hybrid changes the phase structure or management decisions [f9500, f9501, f16422].

relations.note: Glossary specifies physical product development as the scope of the 2016 agile hybrid.
Both attribute Stage-Gate to Cooper in 1990 and 2008; f9501 adds the 2016 hybrid.
Adds the method's defined phases and intervening management decisions to its historical account.
